abstract: Teratomas account for 8-13% of all mediastinal tumors. A 27-year-old patient presented with chest pain and dyspnea of prolonged evolution. A chest X-ray revealed near total opacification of the right hemithorax. On a tomography scan of the chest, a collection of heterogeneous fluid, with irregular borders and 10.1 x 11.7 cm in size, was seen in the pleura of the lower two-thirds of the right hemithorax but was not encroaching on any of the adjacent structures. Based on the hypothesis that these findings represented a benign mediastinal teratoma, an exploratory thoracotomy was performed, during which such a teratoma was found and completely excised. The post-operative evolution was favorable. The atypical presentation and considerable growth of the tumor hindered the pre-operative diagnosis.
abstract_ja: 奇形腫は縦隔腫瘍の8～13%を占める。27歳の患者が長期経過の胸痛と呼吸困難を呈した。胸部X線写真で右半胸郭のほぼ全体の不透明化を認めた。断層撮影では、右胸膜の下方3分の2を占め、隣接構造を圧迫しない、不均一な液体様の集簇像（10.1×11.7 cm）が認められた。良性縦隔奇形腫との仮説に基づき開胸探査術を施行し、奇形腫を確認して完全切除した。術後経過は良好であった。非典型的な提示と腫瘍の著明な増大により術前診断が妨げられた。
